anti-thyroid peroxides antibodies (TPO) are present in the blood of patients with systemic Lupus erythematosu s (SLE), but they are not able to inhibit the activity of the thyroid peroxidase enzyme, which is responsible for the production of thyroid hormones.
the anti-thyroid peroxide antibody activity in sera from patients with systemic lupis erythematosus is different from that in sera from patients suffering thyroid disorders.
the autoantibodies from SLE patients are different from those from thyroid disorder patients, and that they should be considered when evaluating the association between SLE and thyroid disorders.

the study of the role of the thyroid gland in the pathophysiology of autoimmune diseases.
the study of the mechanisms of the autoimmune thyroid diseases, especially of the thyroid autoantigens, and the relationship between SLE and thyroid autoantibodies.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the thyroid peroxidase antibodies found in SLE patients do not inhibit thyroid peroxidase activity.
the thyroid gland is involved in SLE in a significant percentage of patients, but the clinical significance of this involvement has not been clearly demonstrated.
there is a strong association between SLE and hypothyroidism, but no association with autoimmune thyroid disease.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the anti-TPO auto-antibodies in the sera of SLE do not inhibit TPO activity.
anti-TPO antibodies are not a good marker for thyroid dysfunction in SLE patients.
anti-TPO auto-antibodies are not involved in the etiology of SLE.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the thyroid peroxidase antibody test can be used to diagnose Hashimoto thyroiditis and Graves’ disease, as well as other autoimmune disorders.
the presence of thyroid peroxidase antibodies in SLE patients may not necessarily indicate the development of hypothyroidism.
the presence of anti-TPO antibodies is associated with a higher risk of developing SLE in patients with Hashimoto's thyroiditis.
